source: real capture (Wireshark sample set), radiotap + 802.11, 2.4 GHz channel 1
description: Real WPA-PSK Wi-Fi monitor-mode capture: 1093 frames, 35 retries, one Disassociation with reason code 8, radiotap dB antenna signal / rate / channel present.

captureQuality.notes: Signal is dB (radiotap.db_antsignal, values 40-43), NOT dBm. Any rule that reports absolute RSSI in dBm from this file is wrong; report relative signal or withhold.

mustReport.detail: Disassociation from 00:0d:93:82:36:3a to 00:0c:41:82:b2:55, reason code 8 (Disassociated because sending STA is leaving BSS) at t+36.80 s
35 of 1093 frames carry the retry bit (3.2%); retries cluster in two bursts (probe responses ~frames 68-74 and 1007-1023) rather than being uniformly distributed

certaintyGovernance.rssi: withheld - radiotap carries dB antenna signal only, no dBm reference; engine must not emit an absolute-RSSI finding
certaintyGovernance.mcs: withheld - no MCS/VHT/HE radiotap field present
certaintyGovernance.retryCause: at most 'likely' - retry bit alone cannot distinguish interference from range or hidden node

notes: Retry-rate threshold must sit above 0.6% (item 16 baseline) and at/below 3.2%. Reason code 8 must be decoded from a Disassociation (subtype 0x000a), not misread as a Deauthentication.
